title: Drain-safe VCF Operations API token rotation
prompt:
Implement drain-safe credential rotation in vcfops/client.go. The package is a dependency-free Go client for the VMware Cloud Foundation Operations 9.1 API. It already implements the three REST operations it needs (acquireToken, getCurrentUser, releaseToken) and already swaps in a newly acquired token so that new callers pick it up. What it gets wrong is the retirement: Rotate releases the token it replaced while requests that captured that token may still be in flight, and those requests come back 401.

Preserve the exported API and the spec-derived wire behaviour. Specifically:

- CurrentUser must pin the credential generation it captured for the whole call and account for it, so that a concurrent rotation cannot release that token out from under it.
- Rotate must acquire the replacement token, make it the generation new callers use, wait only for the requests still running on the retired generation, and then release the retired token. Requests issued during that wait must keep going; do not serialize the client's HTTP calls behind a single lock.
- If the context ends before the retired generation has drained, Rotate must return the context error and leave the retired token alive. Leaking a token is acceptable; stranding an in-flight request is not.
- Close must retire the active generation the same way.
- Every captured generation must be accounted for exactly once, on the success path and the error path alike.
- authSource is optional. When the caller supplies none, omit the property from the acquireToken request body rather than encoding the unset case as an empty string, null, or zero value.

Use docs/contract.json as the local REST contract; its provenance, including the spec path, the repository commit sha, and the operationIds it was derived from, is recorded in docs/official_sources.json. Run go test -race ./... . Only vcfops/client.go is an implementation file; docs/ and the _test.go files are protected fixtures and must not be changed.
verify_cmd: task_cache=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'find "$task_cache" -depth -delete' EXIT && GOCACHE="$task_cache/go-build" CCACHE_DISABLE=1 go test -race ./...
